questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is centered (e.g., 00:08), there are clearly three writing instruments arranged in a row.
All three items are oriented vertically with the writing end pointing downwards relative to the camera frame.
The two outer pens are black, while the middle pen is grey/silver. They do not share identical colors.
The middle pen shows a pointed writing tip (likely a pencil lead or uncapped tip) at the bottom, whereas the outer two pens have black caps at the bottom. They are not all fully capped.
The board moves smoothly and continuously from left to right throughout the clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board as it moves.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is different from the outer two: it is grey (wrong color) and has an exposed writing tip while the others are capped (missing cap). The nominal condition requires all three pens to be identical.

description: One pen is missing its cap (variant).
